messages:
marta: Hey team — CI smoke on hosted integration turned red a few mins ago for shard-5. Failing in auth + tool-calling flow, looks like 401s when exchanging the proxy token. Minimal repro in logs below.

sam: Ugh, saw that. Is this the same token-rotate flake from last week?

marta: Not exactly, last week was a full token rotate. This one shows a header ordering oddity: agent logs show `Authorization` present but our proxy returns 401 with body 'invalid signature'.

alex: Can you paste the exact request/response? small snippet please.

marta: Sure:
```
POST /v1/tools/call HTTP/1.1
Host: hosted.redwood.ai
User-Agent: smoke-suite/1.2
X-Request-ID: smoke-2024-11-17-01
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 78

{"error":"invalid signature","hint":"signature mismatch for kid=abc123"}
```

jia: Interesting: request is chunked but response includes Content-Length. Could be our proxy normalizer choking on `Transfer-Encoding`. I remember an earlier patch to the reverse-proxy that reordered headers when chunked requests came through.

sam: That proxy change was rolled out 2 days ago to reduce memory for streaming. @alex any recent change to header canonicalization?

alex: I did a small tweak last week to header normalization for streaming cases — it strips `Content-Length` when `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` is present. But I didn't touch auth handling. I'll check my PR.

marta: CI logs show the JWT validation code sees the token but fails signature verification — the `kid` from the error (abc123) doesn't match the JWKS we pulled. JWKS cache TTL was 5m. Could be a race where proxy rewrites cause different kid to be read?

ci-bot: smoke-suite/shard-5 · FAIL · auth-toolcall · last run 5m ago · rerun available · click to trigger /rerun_shard 5

marta: Can someone kick a parallel rerun of shards 4-6? I want to see if it's isolated to 5. If it's flaky we should bisect by commit range for yesterday's infra deploy.

rerun-bot: Command received: /rerun_shard 4-6 — queued. Tracking: RERUN-1745009999-A

sam: I'll monitor the reruns. If the same failure appears across multiple shards it's likely infra. If only 5, maybe a bad node with stale JWKS or unhealthy cache.

alex: I'm bisecting last infra deploys in parallel. Quick check: which service versions are in the failing run?

marta: smoke-matrix shows runtime=2.7.3, proxy=1.14.0, auth-service=3.1.0. The last infra rollout bumped proxy from 1.13.9 -> 1.14.0.

jia: If proxy 1.14.0 introduced header reorder, could flip which kid meta is sent to auth. Also note streaming toolcall path uses chunked encoding more often.

sam: Reruns started: shard-4 PASS, shard-5 FAIL (same 401), shard-6 PASS. So isolated to shard-5.

marta: OK isolate confirmed. @alex can you get us node details for shard-5? IP and proxy version on that host?

alex: Looking — shard-5 is routed to node infra-proxy-5 (proxy=1.14.0) behind edge pool e5. Node shows 6 active connections, no obvious OOM. Pulling proxy logs now.

alex: proxy logs show a WARN: "chunked request with content-length dropped" at 2024-11-17T01:12:34Z, followed by a downstream 401 from auth-service.

jia: Let's try a targeted smoke run hitting infra-proxy-5 directly from the smoke runner with `curl --raw --chunked` to reproduce the header dance. I can spawn a quick local run.

marta: While we do that, can ops rotate the JWKS cache on infra-proxy-5? If it's serving stale keys that could explain the kid mismatch.

sam: Ops pinged: @ops-team can you force JWKS refresh on infra-proxy-5 and confirm?

ops-ping (external): ack, scheduling JWKS refresh now, ETA ~2m.

rerun-bot: RERUN-1745009999-A completed: shard-5 still FAIL. Logs captured at /artifacts/1745009999/shard-5.log

marta: I grabbed the artifact and grepped for kid: shows two different kid headers in rapid succession — `abc123` then `def456` — looks like mixing tokens during streaming handoff.

alex: That's suspicious. Could be a race where a rekey happened while a multi-part request was being proxied and the auth-service saw a partial JWT with old kid. Does the auth-service log show which kid validated?

jia: Running the direct curl now against infra-proxy-5 with chunked payload...

jia: Repro locally: sending chunked req yields 401 and same error about kid=abc123. If I force `Content-Length` (no chunked) request passes.

sam: So proxy 1.14.0's handling of chunked requests is the differentiator. We should hotfix proxy to preserve header ordering and not rewrite kid metadata. Suggest reverting the chunked header normalization as an immediate patch.

alex: I can cut a 1.14.1 hotfix reverting the normalization in ~30m. Do we want a canary on infra-proxy-5 or roll all nodes?

marta: Canary on node infra-proxy-5 first, since that's the failing node. If it passes, roll rest. Also update smoke-suite to include a chunked request test so this doesn't regress unnoticed.

sam: Agreed. Meanwhile ops confirmed JWKS refresh done. No effect. That points back to proxy behavior.

alex: Starting PR to revert the change: https://git.internal.redwood/infrapoxy/PR-289 diff is small. Will request rapid review.

marta: Thanks. Once PR merged, can someone kick a rerun on the shard to validate?

rerun-bot: new rerun trigger available: /rerun_shard 5 (will run on canary proxy group when node updated)

sam: I'm watching CI and will ping here when rerun finishes. :eyes:

(15m later)

sam: Quick update — canary patch applied to infra-proxy-5, rerun started.

rerun-bot: RERUN-1745009999-B in progress — shard-5 on canary proxy (1.14.1-hotfix)

rerun-bot: RERUN-1745009999-B completed: PASS

marta: Nice — patch looks good. Alex, please schedule the broader rollout and post rollback plan. And let's add a small chunked-encoding smoke to our CI matrix.

alex: Will do. Rollout planned in next 10m with staged increments. PR merged and changelog updated.

marta: Closing this thread. Thanks everyone for the quick triage. We'll follow up with postmortem notes in #postmortems if needed. :white_check_mark:
